Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing the artifact creature.

When the creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability, giving it flying until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Repeat from step 1.

1456-4871-5220-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.

Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

240-728-1849-5470.notablePrerequisites:

When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token created in step 1, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1011-2728-4153-6797.easyPrerequisites:

Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 4.

Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.

Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3525-3918-6788.notes: This combo can be repeated whenever you want to cast an artifact spell. If needed as well, you can tap Solar Array for colored mana to use in casting that spell, assuming you do not want to continue the combo after the spell is cast.
